title: Copies after 30 cycles of PCR, by efficiency per cycle
description: Bar chart on a log scale of the copies made from one DNA duplex in 30 cycles of PCR, if each cycle copies a given fraction of the molecules: 100 per cent, about 1.07 billion; 95 per cent, 502 million; 90 per cent, 231 million; 85 per cent, 104 million, the efficiency Cetus measured in 1985; 80 per cent, 46 million. Worked out for kloom from the formula (1 + E) to the power n.
heading: COPIES OF ONE DUPLEX AFTER 30 CYCLES
